scope: Batangas province PSA aggregate; not Lian farm-level
forecast_origin: end of 2025 Q4, before reading 2026 target values
target: production metric tons divided by harvested area hectares
historical_training_data: 1987-2025 PSA quarterly records; 2021-2025 may be used for final pre-2026 refit but not for model selection
selection_method: Phase 28 expanding walk-forward validation and TimeSeriesSplit hyperparameter search on 1987-2016; 2017-2020 validation; no 2026 tuning
r2_policy: reported only as descriptive context because the evaluation has three observations
lag_availability_rule: all 2026 predictions use only records through 2025 Q4; no 2026 target is used to construct any feature, including Q2/Q3 previous-quarter values
decision_rule: Do not select or retune using 2026 outcomes. Report candidate errors individually and assess consistency qualitatively; three rows cannot establish reliable deployment accuracy.
